## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (lint, Python tests, JS tests)
- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit (`fix:`, `feat:`, `feat!:` for breaking changes)
- [ ] Logic that exists in both Python and JS is changed in both, with the shared fixture updated (`tests/twins.json`)
- [ ] New or changed public functions have docstrings / JSDoc
- [ ] Docs updated where they apply: `README.md` (authors), `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `AGENTS.md` (internals)
- [ ] Browser-visible change: checked on the PR preview of the example course
